Fluminense host Cruzeiro on November 27 in the 37th round of Brazil’s Serie A, with third place still within reach for both teams. The visitors are third on 66 points, three ahead of fourth-placed Fluminense, making this a significant meeting near the end of the campaign. Both sides arrive on winning runs and have been scoring consistently: Fluminense have found the net in eight straight games, while Cruzeiro have scored in their last 20. Their previous meeting ended 1-1 on May 31, adding [...] The probable Fluminense lineup under Marcão is Fábio; Guga, Ignácio, Thiago Silva, Renê; Hércules, Nonato; Agustín Cannobio, Lucho Acosta, Savarino; Hulk.

The probable Cruzeiro lineup under Artur Jorge is Otávio; Fagner, Fabrício Bruno, Jesus, Rojas; Matheus Henrique, Zé Lucas; Marquinhos, Matheus Pereira, Gerson; Kaio Jorge. Matheus Henrique’s inclusion remains uncertain because he is listed as a doubt for the match. [...] Fluminense have scored 57 league goals, two fewer than Cruzeiro. Hulk, who has seven Serie A goals, is among 12 Fluminense players at risk of a suspension for the final round if cautioned against Cruzeiro. Alisson, John Kennedy and Matheus Reis remain in the club’s medical department.
